_comment: Formation-density demo: select the Spearmen (seed 12345, ~120,300), zoomed in close enough to see individual mark spacing. Press T twice to cycle Normal -> Tight -> Loose. Tight leaves the marks at the same spacing as Normal (the historical close-order floor); Loose visibly spreads them apart.

overlap.reason: The clip deliberately films a large formation reshape at the new pitch identity; in-transit samples fire the grid metrics (same-owner bodies pass arbitrarily close mid-re-slot by design -- intra-regiment spacing is the formation arrival's job, not steering's -- and routes cross while the grid re-deals). Measured on the new-density re-pin: min neighbour 0.14 wu during the Tight->Loose 1x->4x expansion.
